description: Configure dynamic email routing for the 'IT Incident Report Form 2025' survey. Navigate to the survey settings (Notifications & Data) and configure the 'Send detailed admin notification to' field. Use LimeSurvey's Expression Manager syntax to route notifications: if the question 'Severity' equals 'L1', send to 'pager@example.com'; otherwise, send to 'tickets@example.com'. The syntax format is {if(test, true_result, false_result)}.
